notes: Focused public C++ and Java TCK evidence for IEEE 1516.1-2025 §12.12.4.2 p. 382 l. 27-8, specifically ObjectInstanceHandle decoding. A handle encoded in a source federation is decoded by a joined RTI in a separate federation containing no object instances; the decode must preserve the handle value, while the subsequent semantic name lookup reports ObjectInstanceNotKnown. Java uses ObjectInstanceHandleFactory.decode(byte[], offset), the public Java API path, and verifies equality with the source handle before the local name lookup. The Java ObjectInstanceHandle API has no isValid method, so the test does not claim that C++-specific assertion. This does not imply coverage of every typed decoder or provider conformance.
